Contact.description: For any new projects or new collaborations, I would first like to get to know you and your company through a call or a meeting. Then I would like to understand the context of your company, its goals and long-term objectives. After agreeing on the collaboration and prioritizing tasks, we write an agreement and start the mission in a few days. If you have an interesting topic in mind and want to learn more and hear my expertise, just contact me via the contact form.
